overall_assessment.summary: Architecturally disciplined codebase with genuine attention to lookahead prevention, deterministic feature calculation, and safety defaults. However, the backtest engine is critically incomplete (no stop/target exits), real_backtest.py is a facade, walk-forward is disabled, and survivorship bias is unaddressed.

findings.finding: Backtest exit logic is FIXED_HOLD only - no stop-loss, no target execution, no gap modeling
findings.evidence: engine.py lines 75-103: exit condition is pos.holding_bars >= holding_period_bars only
findings.why_it_matters: Live risk engine uses stop_loss and target_price. Backtest does not. Results are structurally disconnected from live strategy.
findings.risk: All synthetic backtest metrics are invalid for strategy validation purposes.
findings.recommended_fix: Implement stop-loss (low<=stop) and target (high>=target) exit checks. Handle same-bar collision conservatively (stop first).

findings.finding: real_backtest.py contains no actual backtest execution - only preflight + template report
findings.evidence: Lines 82-88: if symbols >= 10: result[predictive_value] = EVIDENCE_OF_PREDICTIVE_VALUE - asserts predictive value from symbol count alone
findings.why_it_matters: Any report generated by this module is misleading. Implies real backtest was run when it was not.
findings.risk: False confidence in system validation capability.
findings.recommended_fix: Implement real backtest logic or rename to data_acceptance_gate.py and wire BacktestEngine as real executor.

findings.finding: Walk-forward disabled by default; existing implementation is single static split not genuine walk-forward
findings.evidence: backtest.yaml line 39: walk_forward.enabled: false; walk_forward.py runs one train/val/test split, no rolling windows

findings.finding: Default universe method is CURRENT_UNIVERSE - survivorship biased
findings.evidence: universe.py line 50: method: str = CURRENT_UNIVERSE. No historical universe database exists.

findings.finding: Score double-counts correlated trend signals; same underlying factor drives 55+ points
findings.evidence: market_scanner.py lines 131-162: price>SMA20, price>SMA50, SMA20>SMA50, EMA20>EMA50, breakout_20d, ret_20d>0, close_pos, ret_20d>0.10 all fire in uptrend

findings.finding: quant_confidence = feature completeness score, semantically treated as evidence of edge
findings.evidence: evidence.py line 143: quant_confidence = total_completeness * 100; risk_engine.py line 93 gates on minimum_confidence 70

findings.finding: Agent2 has no real intelligence - uses MockEvidenceCollector with hardcoded 2020 timestamps
findings.evidence: pipeline.py lines 10-57: MockEvidenceCollector returns hardcoded evidence regardless of symbol or as_of_timestamp

findings.finding: stop_loss and target_price default to 0.0 if not provided - creates invalid risk calculation
findings.evidence: committee.py line 37: stop_loss=quant_data.get(stop_loss, 0.0). If Agent1 does not set these, risk_per_share = entry - 0 = entry

findings.finding: dequeue() reads job file but does not move it to processing directory - crash-after-read causes job duplication
findings.evidence: queue.py lines 49-61: dequeue() reads file but does not move it; file remains in queue directory

findings.finding: Backtest uses fixed-allocation sizing; live mode uses risk-based sizing - strategies are different
findings.evidence: engine.py line 69: fixed_allocation_per_trade = initial_capital / max_positions vs RiskEngine ATR-based risk %

findings.finding: No sector/correlation-aware concentration limit - 5 correlated positions may have 5x modeled risk
findings.evidence: No sector grouping in risk engine; max_portfolio_risk=0.02 assumes position independence

findings.finding: No experiment registry or multiple-testing protection - iterative parameter tuning across 39 batches creates false discovery risk
findings.evidence: Score thresholds, RSI ranges, ATR%, breakout distances set across batches without holdout protection

findings.finding: When LLM is enabled, Agent2 cannot prevent model from using post-as_of_timestamp knowledge
findings.evidence: LLM training cutoff post-dates historical analysis dates; filter_by_timestamp only filters mock data, not model knowledge

findings.finding: SMA-based RSI instead of Wilders Smoothed RSI (EWM)
findings.evidence: Lines 87-88: avg_gain = gain.rolling(14).mean() instead of ewm(com=13, adjust=False).mean()

findings.finding: Flat commission 0.1% may understate Indonesian market costs (broker + exchange + VAT)
except: pass silently swallows JSON parse errors on lesson files
Retry logic classifies errors and records retry but actually calls _to_failed() - retry is not implemented
HIGH_VOLATILITY regime takes priority over BULL/BEAR - regime is mutually exclusive but conceptually should not be
Model names gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-3.1-pro appear speculative/non-existent
walk_forward enabled:false not checked inside WalkForwardValidator.run()
No backtest methodology document, no risk methodology document, root README is 976 bytes
Mutation testing for RSI, SMA, MACD formula verification
Empirical score calibration - plot forward returns by score bucket to validate monotonicity
Correlation ID propagation through all log messages
Feature version hash in DecisionResult for reproducibility
Code version (git hash) in all reports and decision outputs

top_5_priorities.action: Implement stop-loss and target exit in BacktestEngine (core/backtest/engine.py)
Implement real backtest logic or clearly separate real_backtest.py as data acceptance gate only
Validate stop_loss != 0.0 and target_price != 0.0 before risk calculation
Address survivorship bias - require historical universe declaration in dataset gate
Create experiment registry and designate untouched holdout dataset

do_not_add: More technical indicators (SMA/EMA/RSI already over-represented in score)
More LLM agents (3 agents is architecturally sound; 4th adds surface without benefit)
More dashboards/reporting (premature before real data and real backtest)
Broker integration (premature before backtest integrity proven)

conditions_for_go: Fix CRIT-001: Add stop/target exits to BacktestEngine
Fix CRIT-002: Implement real backtest logic
Enable walk-forward or document why single split acceptable

most_important_question.question: Jika besok saya memasukkan dataset IDX historis nyata, apakah sistem ini sudah cukup terpercaya untuk melakukan research-grade backtesting?
most_important_question.explanation: Backtest engine uses FIXED_HOLD only (no stop/target). real_backtest.py has no backtest logic. Survivorship bias unaddressed. Walk-forward disabled. Score not empirically calibrated.

synthetic_validation_label: SYNTHETIC_VALIDATION_ONLY - all existing backtest results must NOT be treated as evidence of profitability, predictive value, edge, or expected return
